name: Larry
source:
Larry is a [URL=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nurarihyon]nurarihyon[/URL]. He's meddlesome and an advisor to the ayakashi. Worried about Momo, who had become all alone, Larry takes her to Gin's shop.
